Episode 27: 5-minute read. Zero fluff : Recirculation: Free Lunch for Frozen Transformers

Take any frozen transformer. Add recurrence at inference time by leaking activations from deep layers back to shallow ones. No retraining. No fine-tuning. Get 23% better perplexity and 21% better math accuracy on GSM8k. The first genuinely free architectural upgrade.

Key findings:
- Inference-time enhancement: introduces recurrence to off-the-shelf frozen models
- 23% perplexity reduction on Gemma3 family across a suite of datasets
- 21% accuracy boost on GSM8k math benchmark - with zero weight changes
- Distinct from looping (depth-only): recirculation is recurrence in BOTH depth and input step
- Trade-off: serial processing in prefill (cannot be parallelized), but zero extra latency during generation

The takeaway? Every deployed transformer just got a free upgrade path - no retraining budget required.
